This is the code repository for the [The History of the Family ](https://doi.org/10.1080/1081602X.2024.2448986) paper 

`Lauster, N., & von Bergmann, J. (2025). The new rules: housing shortage as an explanation for family and household change across large metro areas in Canada, 1981–2021. The History of the Family, 1–30. https://doi.org/10.1080/1081602X.2024.2448986`

This repository contains the paper and code to replicate the analysis.
